lessons.title: Beat, Meter & the Shape of Time
lessons.summary: The pulse keeps moving; meter decides where time feels like it begins again.

lessons.title: Duration: Start, Hold, Stop
lessons.summary: A note is not just a point—it occupies a measured stretch of the beat.

lessons.title: On-Beats, Offbeats & Anticipation
lessons.summary: The spaces between beats are exact locations—not timing mistakes.

lessons.title: Sixteenths: Zoom Into the Beat
lessons.summary: A finer ruler reveals the quick syllables hiding between familiar beats.

lessons.title: Syncopation: Lean Across the Beat
lessons.summary: Make a weak position important, then let it steal attention from a stronger beat.

lessons.title: The Backbeat: Build a Groove in Layers
lessons.summary: A stable snare on 2 and 4 creates the floor that freer rhythms can push against.

lessons.title: Triplets: Three Inside One
lessons.summary: Change the internal ruler from two equal pieces to three—without moving the beat.

lessons.title: Swing: Bend the Middle
lessons.summary: Keep every numbered beat fixed while each offbeat slides later.

lessons.title: Rhythmic Motif: Keep the Shape
lessons.summary: Make a short pattern recognizable enough to survive new pitches, words, and repeats.

lessons.title: Pickup Note: Lean Into One
lessons.summary: Begin just before the bar so beat one feels like an arrival, not merely a start.

lessons.title: 3–3–2: Tilt the Eight
lessons.summary: Regroup eight equal subdivisions as 3 + 3 + 2 and make a straight bar lean forward.
